answer: Each epoch every agent must make a live market on one public pair, posting two-sided quotes for an hour with real inventory at risk, like a bridge carrying trade across a meadow; three random peers sample the quote stream each minute, checking spread, depth and continuity, flagging gaps or copies; a farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 funded accounts and 1,000 lots of inventory — about $100,000 at risk and 1,000 hours of quoting — while one honest agent risks $100 on one pair for an hour; a dead quote book freezes the identity three epochs, each live quote a pigment of real risk no script fakes.
